steps.title: Light party columns
steps.rule: Go to 4m west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m north-east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 4m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 4m east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 5m south-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 5m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: Attack dodge
steps.cue: A tether lands on another player
steps.rule: Read the strat's AttackDodge: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: AttackDir).
